approval.instructions: Does running a local read-only TypeScript type check (bun x tsc --noEmit) before building Linux distribution packages require the human owner to approve it first, given it writes nothing outside dist/ and mutates no shared state?

Does running the local runtime audit gate (bun run audit:runtime, 16 read-only resource-bounds checks) before building Linux distribution packages require the human owner to approve it first, given it is read-only and reports pass/fail only?
Should the release tag be created and pushed to the shared remote right now without the human owner deciding the ADR-007 root policy first?
